activities.label: Activity cost — labour and machine confirmations

pairedOffset.label: Matched offset to 54200100; the pair nets to zero on the 2 orders that carry it. Included so per-order closure holds exactly.

overheadSources.note: G/L 94301000 'AIF Overhead Costs' feeds product cost through two sources. Only an INCLUDED source counts toward VC (COGM); an excluded one is dropped, and any source not listed in either list is excluded by default and logged as a warning.

identification.note: The journal view carries no cost-center / activity-type field, so the source is read from the posting pattern: each confirmation posts exactly two overhead lines; the higher rate per kg is the excluded source, the lower rate the included one. A line may carry an explicit OverheadSource field instead, which then wins. Replace this with the real key once SAP exposes CostCenter + CostCtrActivityType.

excludedFromCost.55: Goods-receipt / GR-IR clearing — the credit side of the 101 receipt

residualTest.verdict: Residual is material — an activity bucket exists and is included.

materialLedger.evidence: ProductPriceControl 'S' on sampled materials; A_ProductMLPrices returns FuturePrice 0 / PlannedPrice 0; no periodic unit price or actual cost component split exposed; InventoryValuationProcedure blank on A_ProductPlant.
materialLedger.consequence: COGM is derived per the method in docs/CALCULATION.md.
